channel.title: Agun Panjika fire alerts
channel.description: Unusual fire activity and fire outlooks for Bangladesh, from harmonised NASA MODIS and VIIRS detections. Describes detected fire, not individual fires.

item.title: Two-week fire outlook elevated: Bangladesh
item.description: 56% chance that the next two weeks are above normal; expected 14 detections (80% range 3 to 19).
